newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, unaffected by crude hike.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, unaffected by crude hike.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Thursday were little changed despite crude gains, traders said.
But indications were very wide ranged. Majors were quoting $126 for 180-cst but independents were lower at $121. Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $121 by majors with independents at $118.
Traders said the market was confused over the near term market direction as overnight crude jumped by close to $1 per barrel. They said cargo prices were unlikely to follow suit.
This uncertainty has kept buyers at the sidelines.
MDO and gasoil prices were unchanged at $218-$223 and $233-$238 respectively. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3082)
